# **1\. System Architecture Overview**

Three-layer architecture. Each layer has a single owner. DB communicates via pg\_notify to Backend. Backend exposes dual API surface: REST for frontend, FHIR R4 for external systems and NPHIES.

| LAYER 1 — DATABASE PostgreSQL 14 | Schema: emr 38 Tables | Triggers | SPs Owner: Alaa Himour | LAYER 2 — BACKEND Java 17 \+ Spring Boot 3 HAPI FHIR 7.2 | pg\_notify Owner: Zeina Itriq | LAYER 3 — FRONTEND React Native \+ Expo TanStack Query | Zustand | FHIR Owner: Mohammad Khalifa |
| :---: | :---: | :---: |

## **1.1 Two Entry Paths**

| Path | Source | entry\_source | transaction\_rid | Msg Row Created |
| ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| Direct / Manual | Clinician → UI → Spring Boot API | MANUAL | NULL | No |
| Integration Message | HIS / Lab / RIS → HL7v2 or FHIR | HL7 / FHIR / DEVICE | FK → emr\_msg\_transaction | Yes |

## **1.2 Message Flow**

HL7/FHIR → POST /emr/integration/inbound → emr\_msg\_inbound → DB Trigger → sp\_emr\_msg\_route() → pg\_notify → Spring Boot Listener → Service → EMR Tables → emr\_msg\_outbound

## **1.3 API Surfaces**

| Surface | Base URL | Used By |
| ----- | ----- | ----- |
| REST API | /api/v1/emr/\* | Mohammad (frontend) — clean JSON responses |
| FHIR R4 API | /api/v1/fhir/\* | External: NPHIES, MOH, Lab, HIS, Insurance |
| FHIR Bundle | /api/v1/fhir/Bundle | Write path for all clinical events (POST) |
| HL7 Inbound | /api/v1/emr/integration/inbound | Integration engine raw message ingestion |

## **1.4 Cross-Cutting Concerns**

| Concern | Implementation |
| ----- | ----- |
| JWT | Bearer token. tenant\_id \+ branch\_id embedded in claims. 15 min access / 7 day refresh. |
| MRN-First | Every transaction checks sp\_emr\_mrn\_check() before write. No orphan data. |
| Master \+ Log | Every entity: master table (current state) \+ log table (full history with JSONB old/new). |
| Soft Delete | is\_deleted \+ deleted\_at \+ deleted\_by on all 38 tables. No physical DELETE ever. |
| Audit | emr\_fhir\_resource\_log tracks every FHIR resource. DB triggers write snapshots. |
| Bilingual | All name fields have \_ar counterpart. UI uses i18next with AR/EN RTL toggle. |
| Notification | sp\_emr\_notif\_fire() called by ADT/SCH triggers. Template-based SMS/WhatsApp. |
| pg\_notify | Channels: emr.adt / emr.orm / emr.oru / emr.sch / emr.notif / emr.error |

# **15\. Sprint Delivery Plan**

| Sprint | Deliverable | Zeina Itriq — Backend | Mohammad Khalifa — Frontend |
| ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| Sprint 13-4 wks | Foundation \+ Patient | Project setup, HAPI FHIR, FhirConfig, PatientEntity+Service+Mapper, FhirPatientController, pg\_notify infra, EMR Dashboard API | Scaffold, Sunbird theme, FHIR parser/builder, Axios+JWT, Zustand, i18n AR/EN, Pages 1-4 |
| Sprint 24-5 wks | ADT \+ ORM \+ ORU | AdtService A01-A05, EncounterService, OrderService+Mapper, ResultService+Mapper, FHIR Bundle processor | Pages 5-15: ADT forms, Encounter List, Order New/List, Result Viewer/List/Critical |
| Sprint 33-4 wks | SCH \+ Vitals \+ Notifications | AppointmentService+Mapper, VitalsService+Mapper, DiagnosisService+Mapper, sp\_emr\_notif\_fire, template resolver | Pages 16-21: Appointment List/Book/Cancel, Vitals Entry/Display, Diagnoses, Pages 28-29 |
| Sprint 42-3 wks | Integration \+ Audit \+ FHIR | HL7 ingest, pg\_notify listeners all channels, FhirResourceLog \+ \_history, Retry endpoint, Dashboard SP | Pages 22-27: Monitor/Transaction/Retry/Dashboard zones. Pages 30-31: Audit/FHIR Capability |
